content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** GOVLAW — **deviation** (redlined at fallback level).

- **Governing law (§15.9, p0822):** Delaware internal law — already at our accepted fallback; no change proposed.
- **Forum (§15.10, p0823–p0827):** All unresolved Disputes were funnelled into final and binding ICDR international arbitration (New York seat, FAA), with only an IP-ownership carve-out to any U.S. federal court and a customary preliminary-injunction carve-out. Arbitration is not the "corresponding Delaware courts" required by the fallback, so the clause fails fallback element 2 on a material term (not walk-away, since the seat is domestic).
- **Cure (3 surgical replaces, minimality gate ok:true):** unresolved Disputes, including IP-ownership matters, now go exclusively to the Delaware state and federal courts; §15.10.2.1 and §15.10.2.2 conformed so the ICDR machinery only operates on a later mutual written agreement to arbitrate, avoiding a dangling arbitration reference. Executive-officer escalation, the §7.5.5 Material Impact expert determination (p0553), and the preliminary injunctive relief carve-out are preserved verbatim.
